name: cairn-mem
description: Persistent memory for your AI that you actually own — local-first, shared across every MCP client, one command to install, a dashboard to see and edit everything. No cloud, no account, no API key.
author: Evelynkaz

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.uitest.json && node dist/scripts/copy-ui-assets.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.uitest.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run verify-package
